purpose: Document city-scope registry evidence and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: The official Kuningan ATR/BPN Land Office portal has current local land-service notices. The official BHUMI ATR/BPN map describes the national parcel layer (`bidang tanah`) and map features. Kuningan Regency also hosts a public map of government land assets, but it is limited to public assets. No schema/full cadastral polygon response for the unchanged Kuningan WUP locator was verified.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Kuningan Regency Land Office portal, with current 2026 land-services notices.
Official ATR/BPN national BHUMI map shell.
Official BHUMI help page says the interactive map integrates with ATR/BPN ATLAS, a platform for agency geospatial data.
Official map-element guide documents displayed layers including land parcels (`bidang tanah`) and land-value zones.
Official Kuningan Regency public asset-land map lists government asset locations; not a general cadastral inventory.
